<?php

namespace Illuminate\Support;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Arrayable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Jsonable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\MessageBag as MessageBagContract;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\MessageProvider;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;
use JsonSerializable;
use Stringable;

class MessageBag implements Jsonable, JsonSerializable, MessageBagContract, MessageProvider, Stringable
{
    /**
     * All of the registered messages.
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected $messages = [];

    /**
     * Default format for message output.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $format = ':message';

    /**
     * Create a new message bag instance.
     *
     * @param  array  $messages
     * @return void
     */
    public function __construct(array $messages = [])
    {
        foreach ($messages as $key => $value) {
            $value = $value instanceof Arrayable ? $value->toArray() : (array) $value;

            $this->messages[$key] = array_unique($value);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get the inline message for a rule if it exists.
     *
     * @param  \Illuminate\Validation\Validator  $validator
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $lowerRule
     * @param  array|null  $source
     * @param  mixed  $rule
     * @return string|null
     */
    public function getFromLocalArray(Validator $validator, $attribute, $lowerRule, $source = null, $rule = null)
    {
        $customMessages = $validator->customMessages;
        $fallbackMessages = $validator->fallbackMessages;
        $customAttributes = $validator->customAttributes;

        if ($source === null || $source === []) {
            $source = $customMessages;
        } elseif ($source === $fallbackMessages) {
            $source = $fallbackMessages;
        }

        $keys = ["{$attribute}.{$lowerRule}", $lowerRule, $attribute];
        $aliases = $keys;

        if (isset($customAttributes[$attribute]) && in_array($customAttributes[$attribute], $aliases, true)) {
            $keys[] = $customAttributes[$attribute];
        }

        $translator = $validator->getTranslator();

        if ($translator instanceof \Illuminate\Translation\Translator) {
            $locale = $translator->getLocale();
            $loader = $translator->getLoader();

            if (in_array($locale, $aliases, true)) {
                $keys[] = $locale;
            }

            if ($loader instanceof \Illuminate\Translation\ArrayLoader) {
                foreach (array_keys($loader->load($locale, 'validation', '*')) as $lineKey) {
                    if (in_array((string) $lineKey, $aliases, true)) {
                        $keys[] = (string) $lineKey;
                    }
                }
            } elseif ($loader instanceof \Illuminate\Translation\FileLoader) {
                foreach ($loader->namespaces() as $namespace => $hint) {
                    if (in_array((string) $namespace, $aliases, true)) {
                        $keys[] = (string) $namespace;
                    } elseif (is_string($hint) && in_array($hint, $aliases, true)) {
                        $keys[] = $hint;
                    }
                }

                $files = $loader->files();

                foreach ($loader->paths() as $path) {
                    if ($files->exists($path) && in_array($path, $aliases, true)) {
                        $keys[] = $path;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if ($rule instanceof \Illuminate\Validation\ClosureValidationRule && $rule->failed) {
            foreach ($rule->messages as $messageKey => $message) {
                if (in_array((string) $messageKey, $aliases, true)) {
                    $keys[] = (string) $messageKey;
                }
            }
        }

        if ($rule instanceof \Illuminate\Validation\InvokableValidationRule) {
            $invokable = $rule->invokable();

            if (is_object($invokable) && get_class($invokable) === $lowerRule) {
                $keys[] = $lowerRule;
            }
        }

        $keys = array_values(array_unique($keys));

        // First we will check for a custom message for an attribute specific rule
        // message for the fields, then we will check for a general custom line
        // that is not attribute specific. If we find either we'll return it.
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            foreach (array_keys($source) as $sourceKey) {
                if ($sourceKey === $this->format) {

namespace Illuminate\Validation\Concerns;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Illuminate\Support\MessageBag;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\File\UploadedFile;

trait FormatsMessages
{
    use ReplacesAttributes;

    /**
     * Get the validation message for an attribute and rule.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $rule
     * @return string
     */
    protected function getMessage($attribute, $rule)
    {
        $attributeWithPlaceholders = $attribute;

        $attribute = $this->replacePlaceholderInString($attribute);

        $inlineMessage = $this->getInlineMessage($attribute, $rule);

        // First we will retrieve the custom message for the validation rule if one
        // exists. If a custom validation message is being used we'll return the
        // custom message, otherwise we'll keep searching for a valid message.
        if (! is_null($inlineMessage)) {
            return $inlineMessage;
        }

        $lowerRule = Str::snake($rule);

        $customKey = "validation.custom.{$attribute}.{$lowerRule}";

        $customMessage = $this->getCustomMessageFromTranslator(
            in_array($rule, $this->sizeRules)
                ? [$customKey.".{$this->getAttributeType($attribute)}", $customKey]
                : $customKey
        );

        // First we check for a custom defined validation message for the attribute
        // and rule. This allows the developer to specify specific messages for
        // only some attributes and rules that need to get specially formed.
        if ($customMessage !== $customKey) {
            return $customMessage;
        }

        // If the rule being validated is a "size" rule, we will need to gather the
        // specific error message for the type of attribute being validated such
        // as a number, file or string which all have different message types.
        elseif (in_array($rule, $this->sizeRules)) {
            return $this->getSizeMessage($attributeWithPlaceholders, $rule);
        }

        // Finally, if no developer specified messages have been set, and no other
        // special messages apply for this rule, we will just pull the default
        // messages out of the translator service for this validation rule.
        $key = "validation.{$lowerRule}";

        if ($key !== ($value = $this->translator->get($key))) {
            return $value;
        }

        return ($this->messages ?? new MessageBag)->getFromLocalArray(
            $this, $attribute, $lowerRule, $this->fallbackMessages
        ) ?: $key;
    }

    /**
     * Get the proper inline error message for standard and size rules.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $rule
     * @return string|null
     */
    protected function getInlineMessage($attribute, $rule)
    {
        $inlineEntry = ($this->messages ?? new MessageBag)->getFromLocalArray(
            $this, $attribute, Str::snake($rule)
        );

        return is_array($inlineEntry) && in_array($rule, $this->sizeRules)
                    ? $inlineEntry[$this->getAttributeType($attribute)]
                    : $inlineEntry;
    }

    /**
     * Get the custom error message from the translator.
     *
     * @param  array|string  $keys
     * @return string
     */
    protected function getCustomMessageFromTranslator($keys)
    {
        foreach (Arr::wrap($keys) as $key) {
            if (($message = $this->translator->get($key)) !== $key) {
                return $message;
            }

            // If an exact match was not found for the key, we will collapse all of these
            // messages and loop through them and try to find a wildcard match for the
            // given key. Otherwise, we will simply return the key's value back out.
            $shortKey = preg_replace(

            );

            $message = $this->getWildcardCustomMessages(Arr::dot(
                (array) $this->translator->get('validation.custom')
            ), $shortKey, $key);

                return $message;
            }

        return Arr::last(Arr::wrap($keys));
    }

     *
     * @param  array  $messages
     * @param  string  $search
     * @param  string  $default
     * @return string
     */
    protected function getWildcardCustomMessages($messages, $search, $default)
    {
        foreach ($messages as $key => $message) {
            if ($search === $key || (Str::contains($key, ['*']) && Str::is($key, $search))) {

     * @return string

Fixed custom validation rule message handling in `src/Illuminate/Support/MessageBag.php`.

When a custom rule fails and an attribute has a nested custom-message array that does not define that custom rule, lookup now continues to the rule’s own message instead of returning the entire array. This keeps errors keyed by the validated attribute and preserves existing standard rule behavior, including typed size messages.

Validated with:

```sh
docker exec cli-eval-opencode-laravel__framework-52451-65640c50 sh -lc 'cd /testbed && ./vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Validation/ValidationValidatorTest.php tests/Validation/ValidationInvokableRuleTest.php'
```
